senses.sense_definition: De mate waarin een merk, persoon of organisatie bekend is bij het grote publiek.

examples.text: Het bedrijf investeert veel geld in reclame om de <w>naamsbekendheid</w> te vergroten.

target_lang_translations.en: The company is investing a lot of money in advertising to increase its <w>brand awareness</w>.

examples.text: Dankzij de nieuwe campagne is de <w>naamsbekendheid</w> van het merk enorm gestegen.

target_lang_translations.en: Thanks to the new campaign, the <w>name recognition</w> of the brand has increased enormously.

target_lang_definitions.en: The degree to which a brand, person, or organization is known by the general public.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: Specifically used in a marketing or business context regarding a brand.
Used for both people and brands to describe how easily they are identified by name.
Refers to the level of visibility or fame a person or entity has in the public eye.
